module "P_Descriptions.dsp"

product 0 PassPipeline "P_Descriptions"
  pipeline order=0 injection=BeforePostProcess views=Game|Editor requires=- enabled=-
  parameter "Noise" Texture2D default=None desc="The noise the grade reads.\nTwo lines of it."
  parameter "Fallback" Texture2D default="/Engine/EngineResources/DefaultTexture"
  buffer "Mood" RGBA8 resolution=Render scale=1 (inferred) clear=(0, 0, 0, 0) mips=1 export desc="Free text above a buffer."
  pass "Grade" copy injection=BeforePostProcess desc="A pass described by its directive."
    read SceneColor = SceneColor
    write Mood = Mood
